sources.title: Adobe: optimizing JPEG images
sources.evidence_scope: Lossy reproduction can produce block-like and wave-like image artifacts.
sources.claim_limit: An authored block-like appearance does not prove that the generated file was encoded by a particular JPEG compressor.

sources.title: Adobe: aliasing and anti-aliasing
sources.evidence_scope: Fine repeated patterns can produce aliasing and moire-like image interference.
sources.claim_limit: Pixel appearance does not identify the sensor, demosaicing algorithm or display that caused interference.

sources.title: Fujifilm: instax film
sources.evidence_scope: Manufacturer film products and picture-area formats, not a universal instant-film color recipe.
sources.claim_limit: The proposed tonal treatment is an authored option and establishes no actual film process; a paper border is not automatically required.
